$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHN (AIP France, chart dated 2026-08-06): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Bellegarde - Vouvray

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Possible derogation for home-based ACFT.
Glider activity reserved for gliders authorized by the AD operator.
TORA and TODA RWY 36 reduced due to road gauge in RWY strip.
Access to South hangars: the distance between the two buildings facing hangar 5 is only 17 meters, thus only one ACFT at a time can be manoeuvring engine running.
Gyroplane and helicopter training activity subject to agreement of AD operator.
Presence of numerous power cables without marking, crossing the Rhône river.
Heavy paragliding activity NE and SW of AD.
Particular weather conditions: wind shear and down draughts from North sector wind, notably on landing and take off at QFU 003°.
Due to topography, RWY length and slope climbing 1.5 %, weak performances hazards requiring weight limitation for most light ACFT, notably at QFU 003°.
Central TWY: follow the centreline because it is asphalted on 6.3 m wide.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Transversal slope of RWY: slope descending 3% from West to East.
Except emergency, avoid go-arounds on final RWY 36 above housing estate.
SAT, SUN and public HOL: traffic pattern reserved for home-based aircraft.
ULM: High approach recommended for LDG on QFU 003°; Traffic pattern: avoid overflight of motorway A40.
Aerobatics NR 6807: see AIP ENR 5.5
AD réservé aux aéronefs munis de radio.
Possibilité de dérogation pour les aéronefs basés.
Activité VAV réservée aux planeurs autorisés par l'exploitant AD.
TORA et TODA RWY 36 réduites cause gabarit routier dans la bande de piste.
Accès aux hangars Sud : l'espace entre les deux bâtiments face au hangar 5 étant de 17 m seulement, un seul appareil à la fois peut y manoeuvrer moteur tournant.
Activité d'entraînement en autogyre et hélicoptère soumise à l'accord de l'exploitant AD.
Présence de nombreuses lignes électriques non balisées traversant le Rhône.
Forte activité parapente au NE et SW de l'AD.
Conditions aérologiques particulières : cisaillement et rabattants par vents de secteur Nord, notamment en QFU 003° au décollage et à l'atterrissage.

Cause topographie, longueur des pistes et pente montante moyenne de 1,5 %, risques de faibles performances nécessitant des limitations de masse pour la plupart des avions légers, notamment en QFU 003°.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
Profil en travers : pente descendante moyenne 3% d'Ouest en Est.
Sauf urgences, éviter les remises de gaz en finale RWY 36 au-dessus du lotissement.
SAM, DIM et JF : entraînement TDP réservés aux aéronefs basés.
ULM : Présentation haute recommandée en configuration. LDG QFU 003°. Tour de piste : éviter le survol de l'autoroute A40.
Voltige N° 6807 : voir AIP ENR 5.5
